Pollard's rho and p - 1 factoring

Source: R/ntheory.R
pollard_rho.Rd

pollard_rho(n) searches for a nontrivial factor of n with the sequence x -> x^2 + a started at s, or with the function F, retrying with random parameters. pollard_pm1(n, B) uses Pollard's p - 1 method with smoothness bound B. Both return a factor or NULL. The random retries use a stream private to the call, seeded by seed, so the results are reproducible but differ from SymPy's.

Usage

pollard_rho(
  n,
  s = 2,
  a = 1,
  retries = 5,
  seed = 1234,
  max_steps = NULL,
  F = NULL
)

pollard_pm1(n, B = 10, a = 2, retries = 0, seed = 1234)

Arguments

n

An integer greater than 4 (pollard_rho()) or 3 (pollard_pm1()).

s

Starting value.

a

Constant of the default polynomial, or base for p - 1.

retries

Number of retries with new random parameters.

seed

Seed for the retries.

max_steps

Maximum number of steps per attempt.

F

A function of one big integer to use instead of x^2 + a.

B

Smoothness bound, greater than 2.

Value

A factor, or NULL.

Examples

pollard_rho(8051)
#> [1] 97
pollard_pm1(21477639576571, B = 4000)
#> [1] 4410317
